title: Bloody Sunday: troops fire on marchers in St. Petersburg
summary: Imperial troops fired on a peaceful procession of workers led by the priest Georgy Gapon who were marching to the Winter Palace to petition the Tsar, killing and wounding hundreds.
reason: Workers were suffering harsh conditions and defeat in the war with Japan had increased discontent with autocratic rule.
significance: The massacre sparked the Russian Revolution of 1905 and destroyed popular faith in the Tsar.
